title: dashboards: a widget filterBindings key naming an undeclared dashboard filter is accepted at draft and publish (silently inert)
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a product defect found by a QA run (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8).

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase and sign in as admin.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/qa_probe_badbind?mode=draft` with body:
   `{"name":"qa_probe_badbind","label":"x","widgets":[{"id":"aa","type":"metric","title":"b","dataset":"showcase_task_metrics","values":["task_count"],"filterBindings":{"no_such_filter":"status"}}]}`
3. `POST /api/v1/meta/dashboard/qa_probe_badbind/publish`.
4. Expected: a refusal naming the unknown filter, as a binding to an unknown FIELD is refused (422, author-time rule `dashboard-filter-field-unknown`).
5. Actual: draft 200 and publish 200. The binding names no declared filter and does nothing at runtime.

## Mechanism
`packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts` checks only the effective bound field. No rule checks that each `filterBindings` key names a filter the dashboard declares. A typo in the filter name (for example `regoin`) therefore publishes clean, and the widget silently ignores the filter it was meant to opt out of or re-target.

QA-source: #27441 · dashboards.global-filters-rescope · observed beside the clauses
